name: LR87
tagline: Twin-chamber hypergolic first stage that flew every Gemini crew
description: The LR87 is the engine that launched all ten crewed Gemini missions on Titan II. Aerojet's design places two combustion chambers on a single turbopump assembly, burning Aerozine-50 and nitrogen tetroxide in a gas-generator cycle — a hypergolic combination that was standard equipment in American ICBMs of the era. The propellant choice had a direct consequence for crew safety: unlike RP-1 or hydrogen, Aerozine-50 and N2O4 ignite on contact, giving a hypergolic reliability that let Gemini fly with ejection seats rather than a launch-escape tower across all ten crewed missions. The LR87 was later developed into larger variants that flew on Titan III and Titan IV commercial and military missions through October 2005.
best_known_for: The twin-chamber first stage that launched Gemini crews on Titan II
